description: This file defines the 'CoreExtension' class for Twig, providing core extension functionalities such as filters, functions, tests, operators, and attribute handling. It includes methods for date formatting, string manipulation, array helpers, security checks, and enum support, among others.

classes.name: CoreExtension
classes.description: Defines core Twig extension functionalities, including filters, functions, tests, operators, and attribute access logic.

methods.name: setDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the default date format strings used by the date filter.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the current default date format strings.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone for date operations.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Retrieves the current default timezone.

methods.name: setNumberFormat
methods.description: Sets the default number formatting options.

methods.name: getNumberFormat
methods.description: Returns the current number formatting options.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Provides the list of custom token parsers used in Twig templates.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig filters provided by this extension.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig functions provided by this extension.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns an array of custom tests available in Twig.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Provides node visitors for the extension (empty in this case).

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Defines operator precedence and associativity for expression parsing.

methods.name: cycle
methods.description: Cycles through a sequence of values.

methods.name: random
methods.description: Returns a random value, potentially selecting from a sequence, a string, or generating a random number.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date object or timestamp according to a specified format.

methods.name: modifyDate
methods.description: Returns a new date object modified by a given interval string.

methods.name: sprintf
methods.description: Provides string formatting functionality.

methods.name: dateConverter
methods.description: Converts and formats a date using the environment's extension.

methods.name: convertDate
methods.description: Converts an input to a DateTime object, handling timestamps, date strings, and DateTime instances.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs string replacement based on a mapping or array.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number with specified precision and method.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number with custom decimal and thousands separator.

methods.name: urlencode
methods.description: URL-encodes a string or array.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges multiple arrays or Traversable objects.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Slices an array, Traversable, or string.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first element of an array, Traversable, or string.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last element of an array, Traversable, or string.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins array elements into a string with a separator.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array based on a delimiter.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Returns a default value if the input is empty.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns the keys of an array or Traversable.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the order of array, Traversable, or string.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomly shuffles an array, Traversable, or string.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of a variable.

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase.

methods.name: striptags
methods.description: Removes HTML and PHP tags from a string.

methods.name: titleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Capitalizes the first character of a string.

methods.name: callMacro
methods.description: Calls a macro method on a Twig template.

methods.name: ensureTraversable
methods.description: Ensures that a variable is iterable.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts a Traversable or array to an array.

methods.name: testEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a variable is considered empty.

methods.name: testSequence
methods.description: Checks if a variable is a sequence (list type array).

methods.name: testMapping
methods.description: Checks if a variable is a mapping (associative array or object).

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes and renders another Twig template.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns the source code of a template without rendering.

methods.name: enumCases
methods.description: Returns all cases of a PHP enum.

methods.name: enum
methods.description: Returns an enum case.

methods.name: constant
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a constant, possibly using an object or class context.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Divides items into batches of specified size.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Accesses an attribute or method of an object or array.
